title: Building this chill driving sim world using Opus 5.5 & Astra
author: aniketjatav
selftext:
Been working on another concept after my [last post here](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1wl2huy/i_built_a_ghibli_style_train_sim_world_using_astra/). I'm working on a blog article to share my full workflow. But here's how I have been building these  
  
\- Images: I start each game with concept art, and a lot of it. I mostly use Codex/Nano banana for this. Once I feel strongly about an art direction, I ask codex to make more images of the world and its assets.  
  
\- Assets: Its a mix of using 2d sprite animation inside a 3d world. All characters here are sprite animation built with own my skills/harness for 2d, but default codex prompts also does the job well.  
  
\- 3d assets: I ask Opus 5.5 to match the world and 3d assets as closely as possible and keep refining and bringing the scene together. After couple hours, the end the result is something like this demo.

  
You can explore this demo world here: [https://app.usecrayon.ai/play/b42413e5-669e-4fb3-87d3-a3285567736c](https://app.usecrayon.ai/play/b42413e5-669e-4fb3-87d3-a3285567736c)

I do not use any gauntlet loop its a token burner lol. I rather prefer to build these projects in a more guided loop.
